phase1_leaf_result.part109_scope: Bounded official-GitHub audit of automatic immutable-release attestation discoverability/retention as a service-side anti-rollback witness.
phase1_leaf_result.new_positive: Creating an immutable release automatically generates a cryptographically verifiable release attestation binding release tag, commit SHA and release assets; GitHub also states the attestation uses Sigstore bundle format, so no separate attestation-creation write is needed.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: Retrieved official verification is release/tag-centric and does not document a stable release-attestation ID/URI or retrieval after release deletion/repository delete-recreate. Portable verification of a possessed bundle is not stateless rediscovery. Ordinary artifact-attestation transparency-log semantics were not generalized to release attestations without an explicit official connection.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: Explicit zero-quota post-deletion lookup/retention semantics for automatic immutable-release attestations, or another independently queryable service-side anti-ABA witness.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Only retrieved official GitHub immutable-release, release-verification, changelog and artifact-attestation comparison documentation; no release/tag/settings/attestation mutation and no cross-role/O/downstream input.

continuation: Part110: execute one bounded official-GitHub public-source leaf on GitHub attestation retrieval surfaces. Audit REST/CLI subject-digest or bundle lookup and require an explicit official statement that automatic immutable-release attestations are covered; test documented retention after release deletion/repository delete-recreate, stable repository-independent identity or transparency-log locator, and zero finite monthly/trial/paid quota or paid-plan dependency. Do not infer release-attestation coverage from ordinary artifact-attestation APIs. If coverage or post-deletion retention is undocumented, fail closed and persist the next candidate without executing it in the same invocation.
